plan.focus: Evaluate the importance of reputation versus short-term strategies in marketing for consumer goods companies.
keyArguments: Building a strong reputation fosters trust and long-term customer loyalty.
While short-term strategies like discounts and special offers can drive immediate sales, they may not sustain long-term success.
